# AirbrushDOC

> Airbrush guides, honest equipment reviews, step-by-step tutorials, and free stencils. Written and personally tested by one artist (15+ years: automotive, t-shirt, fine art) — publishing since 2010. Reviews are hands-on; affiliate-partner products have been publicly criticized when warranted. Tagline: Cures for Your Canvas.

Contact: contact@airbrushdoc.com — Author: [Sergej Voronko](https://airbrushdoc.com/about/)

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://airbrushdoc.com/): site overview and latest guides

- [Interactive Tools](https://airbrushdoc.com/tools/): free airbrush tools ("The Clinic")
